correctness.rationale: Exact beta moments give selfadjoint Legendre eigenvalues. The artanh identity proves sharp integer clock and Loewner comparison. The uniform O((n+1)^-2) order bound is summable, permitting trace-norm dominated convergence and exact constants; a separate summable expansion proves fixed-offset uniqueness. The standalone quadrature checker passes 148 finite assertions and is supplementary only.

value.rationale: Exact optimal iteration count to approximate a natural diffusion semigroup, a nontrivial one-sided operator-order bound at every finite degree, and a full trace-ideal second-order asymptotic distinguish it from routine single-step eigenvalue calculations. Unique cancellation of first-order error and explicit best trace/operator constants make the precise result useful for accelerated Markov-to-diffusion approximation.
